result.summary: The page is largely well-designed. One notable visual defect: the profile/avatar button in the top-right corner renders as an empty gray circle with a small red notification dot but no visible icon or image, making it look broken or unfinished.

issues.description: The circular profile/avatar button in the top-right header appears as a blank light-gray circle containing only a tiny red notification dot. There is no visible user icon, avatar image, or glyph, so the control looks empty/broken and its purpose is unclear.
issues.suggestion: Render a default user/profile icon or avatar image inside the circle (and ensure the notification badge is anchored to a visible element). If the avatar failed to load, add a fallback icon or placeholder.

issues.description: The red notification dot on the profile button has no accompanying text or badge count, and the button has no visible label, which may be unclear for screen-reader and low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Add an accessible label (e.g., 'Profile, 1 notification') and consider a count badge or text indicator in addition to the color-only dot.
